passive.name: Voracity
passive.description:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

primaryAbilities.name: Bouncing Blade
primaryAbilities.description: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Katarina throws a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor>, dealing <magicDamage>{{ totaldamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to the target and {{ maxbounces }} nearby enemies. The <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Preparation
primaryAbilities.description: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Katarina tosses a <keywordMajor>Dagger</keywordMajor> into the air and gains <speed>{{ movespeedamount }}% Move Speed</speed> decaying over {{ movespeedduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Shunpo
primaryAbilities.description: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for {{ totaldamage }} magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range.

Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ daggercooldownreduction }} seconds ({{ tooltipdaggerreduction }}). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Death Lotus
primaryAbilities.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals {{ damagecalc }} magic damage and {{ addamagecalc }} physical damage, and applies {{ grievousamount*100 }}% Grievous Wounds for {{ grievousduration }} seconds.

Total over {{ duration }} seconds to each enemy: {{ totaldamagecalc }} magic damage and {{ totaladdamagecalc }} physical damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
